title: Two sum
statement:
Given an array nums and an integer target, return the indices of two different elements that add up to target. Exactly one pair does; return it in any order.

Constraints: up to 2 × 10⁴ elements.
hints: For each element x, which value would complete the pair?
Store each value's index in a hash map as you go, and look up target − x first.

solution.explanation: One pass with a map from value to index: for element x at index i, if target − x has been seen, return its index and i; otherwise record x. Looking up before inserting handles [3, 3] correctly. O(n) time. The brute force is O(n²); sorting with two pointers is O(n log n) but loses the original indices unless you carry them.
